import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('build/pow2-widths');jobs=json.loads((b/'jobs.json').read_text());rows=[];widths={}
for j in jobs:
 g=j['grammar_name']
 if g not in widths:
  cmd=[str(b/'metadata'),j['grammar']['library'],j['grammar']['symbol']]
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
  assert p.returncode==0,(g,p.stderr)
  v=list(map(int,p.stdout.split()));widths[g]=dict(zip(['supertype_count','dictionary_count','super_bits','field_count','field_bits','symbol_bits'],v))
 cmd=[str(b/'binaries/exact-p1/query-workload'),str(b/'jobs'/(j['name']+'.json')),'--repeat','1']
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 row=dict(job=j['name'],returncode=p.returncode,stderr=p.stderr)
 if p.returncode==0:row['measured']=json.loads(p.stdout)
 rows.append(row)
 (b/'local-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');(b/'grammar-widths.json').write_text(json.dumps(widths,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(j['name'],p.returncode,p.stderr[-350:] if p.returncode else '',flush=True)
scripts.expand-pow2.py:
import json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('build/pow2-widths');jobs=json.loads((b/'jobs.json').read_text());out=b/'expanded';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(out/'jobs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
old=set((b/'corpus-files.txt').read_text().splitlines());new=set((b/'corpus-files-expanded.txt').read_text().splitlines())-old
specs=[('glsl','godotengine--godot',{'.glsl','.frag','.vert','.comp','.geom','.tesc','.tese'}),('systemverilog','lowRISC--ibex',{'.sv','.svh'}),('systemverilog','openhwgroup--cva6',{'.sv','.svh'}),('nu','nushell--nu_scripts',{'.nu'})]
result=[];audit=[]
for grammar,repo,extensions in specs:
 candidates=[]
 for filename in new:
  p=Path(filename)
  if repo not in p.parts or p.suffix not in extensions:continue
  size=p.stat().st_size
  if 1024<=size<=2*1024*1024:candidates.append((size,str(p.resolve())))
 candidates=sorted(candidates)[-100:];template=next(j for j in jobs if j['grammar_name']==grammar)
 cmd=[str(b/'parse-check'),template['grammar']['library'],template['grammar']['symbol']]+[p for _,p in candidates]
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);assert r.returncode==0,(grammar,r.stderr)
 flags=list(map(int,r.stdout.split()));good=[p for p,f in zip(candidates,flags) if not f]
 audit.append(dict(grammar=grammar,repo=repo,candidates=[dict(size=s,path=p,has_errors=f) for (s,p),f in zip(candidates,flags)],clean=len(good)))
 print(grammar,repo,len(good),'/',len(candidates),'largest clean',good[-1][0] if good else None,flush=True)
 if not good:continue
 small=list(dict.fromkeys(good[i*len(good)//4][1] for i in [1,2,3]))
 for size_class,paths in [('small',small),('large',[good[-1][1]])]:
  j=json.loads(json.dumps(template));j['name']=f'{grammar}-{repo}-{size_class}-highlights';j['case']=f'{grammar}-{repo}-{size_class}';j['size_class']=size_class
  j['sources']=[dict(path=p,sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in paths];result.append(j)
  (out/'jobs'/(j['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(j,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'jobs.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');(out/'selection-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2)+'\n')
